name: Avon Global Communications
summary: Early Avon Valley / Perth ISP (avon.net.au); home-page creation, internet classes and gateway for local business/tourism; WAIA and TIO member; operated from 1996 into the 2010s.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of avon.net.au Dec 1996; WAIA/TIO member from 1998.
Website last captured 2005; still listed on TIO/WAIX into 2011.
